positive_snippets:
Landed at IGI Airport New Delhi in the mid night and need to catch another flight after few hours…..feeling tired and sleepy….want to rest a bit with reasonable price and very good experience….then check-in into Hotel Zest.”
It is a new Property and very well maintained. Hotel staff is very kind and helpful. They welcome you with a big smile and friendly atmosphere. Food is another plus point. My family had a great experience here and will plan to stay again during our return trip.
Please try once and get the same experience. 🙏

Hotel zest is a great place to stay! The rooms are large and very comfortable. You can relax and feel at home. The lobby is tidy and welcoming. It looks nice when you walk in. The rooms are clean, which makes your stay even better. Everything feels fresh and pleasant. I really enjoyed my time here! Highly recommend this hotel for a lovely experience!
8. The (Hotel zest near igi airport) has the perfect blend of historic charm and modern facilities. I booked one of their spacious suites, which were decorated beautifully. A truly memorable stay!
negative_snippets:
Worst service and a complete scam. I checked in on 24 February 2026 for two days.

On the phone, they clearly said the charge would be ₹1,250 per day, totaling ₹2,500 for two days in a whatsApp chat,( it was also showing 1250 online booking that time per day when I was booking).

but at the time of checkout, they changed their statement to ₹2,500 per day and collected a total of ₹5,000.

This is a pure scam. Never trust their phone booking system, and make sure to record all conversations.

Stayed 2 nights told there was an airport shuttle and breakfast. There is not there is no restaurant, used shower tap fell off.

In a sleazy part of Delhi

Basic room tried to pay by credit card which is international unable to use. Had to go to ATM to pay cash.

Hotel is for locals only not for international travellers.
